name: com.ireshsampath.unity-assets.easy-serial
description:
EasySerial is a lightweight Unity asset for simple, reliable serial communication. Easily read and write serial data for sensors, hardware interfaces, microcontrollers, and custom devices.

Note: To use System.IO.Ports, change the API Compatibility Level to .NET Framework in Project Settings > Player.

samples.description: A sample scene demonstrating how to initialize, read, and write serial data using EasySerial.
